Name: Ashley Gregoire
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

The interpreting Visual Texts is the most usable in my teaching context because I teach Geography, World History, and American History. Students need to be able to find the meaning from illustrations, graphs, and diagrams in our textbooks in order understand what they are learning. In often times, I revist how to properly read and analyze maps, graphs, and diagrams so they don't lose the ability to learn from them.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
I use Interpreting Visual Texts often. Students learn differently and visual aids help boost their learning.
